title: 第六章 要守护一生的人第七章 战争到来
lines: 螓首娥眉，紫发玉颊，曼妙少女，轻吐莲香。小南靠在床头，如同睡美人一样优雅的沉浸在梦中，红唇微翘，带有一丝笑意。
夜天云仔细回忆起昨夜的事迹，蓦然发现梦境太过真实，心中猜测，隐隐得到了答案。
“昨夜的梦，是小南么？”夜天云如实想到，看到趴在床边安静的小南，些许湿润的毛巾平躺在枕旁，心中产生了一丝温暖，一丝感激。
“这小丫头还挺有心。”夜天云脸上挂着满足的笑容，为小南抚平了有些散乱的秀发。
小南嘤咛一声，悠悠醒来，由于靠在床边睡了整晚，她还有些迷迷糊糊，眼神有些朦胧，有些呆滞，迷茫的环顾四周。
“回神啦。”夜天云伸出五指拍了拍小南的脸颊，柔软的触感倒是让夜天云颇为受用。
“啊，天云，你醒了。”小南清醒了过来，回忆起昨晚的事，心中微微发窘，脸上又出现来了一丝红晕，一时之间无言以对。
虽然不甚明显，但夜天云为何人，作为顶级杀手的他自然轻易的捕捉到了这一丝变化，思维运转，将所发生的事情推测了一遍，顿时了解到小南现在心中的尴尬。想到此处，夜天云的心中也是有些发窘，同时还有些惊奇，毕竟小南只是个九岁的少女，虽然漫画中的火影世界的人们都有些早熟，但这也太早了吧。
二人心中各怀所思，屋内顿时安静下来，寂静无话。不过此时的气氛看起来有些奇怪，有些沉闷，有些尴尬，但还透出微微的暧昧。
不过夜天云并没在意到这些，率先走出了思绪，打破了宁静。
“小南，你怎么在我的房中？”
话题被成功的转移，小南心中的尴尬也被驱散了大半，开始缓缓托出了昨晚的前因后果。”天云，你是不是有什么心事。”小南问出了昨夜的疑惑，双眼看着夜天云期待着他的回答。
夜天云笑了一下，摇了摇头，只不过笑容略显苦涩，眼中的悲伤一闪即没。
“对不起，天云。”意识到了夜天云的惆怅，小南暗怪自己的不谨慎，有些歉意的说道。
“没事的。”看着有些慌乱的小南，夜天云不禁感叹小南的善良，同时心中对小南的感激又增了一分。
“天云，虽然我们只是萍水相逢，但你救助了我，帮助了我，如果心中有什么苦楚不要自己承担，我希望有一天能够让我帮你一起分担，我一直把你当成我的弟弟，我的父母已经死了，你，是我最亲近的人，我们会一起生活下去，在这乱世，找到我们的安身之地，永远的生活下去！”
小南的语气温婉轻柔，然话语却坚毅如松石。微笑的脸庞如春风拂柳温暖着疮痍的内心，夜天云看着小南，久久不能平静。
“谢谢你。”声音也有些发颤，时隔多年再次品尝到了被人关心的感觉，夜天云强压下翻涌的内心。
“嘻嘻。”小南灿烂一笑，转身向屋外走去。”一会儿吃饭吧。”声音传来，欣喜异常。
孤独半生，唯有利刃相伴，杀戮十载，终无知心一人。念前世，锋锐染血空利，幽夜独自神伤，可叹幸福温馨，只存午夜梦回。到今生，纤纤娇柔少女，引动三千思绪，抚平疮痍内心，许诺倾世誓言。
夜天云看着小南娇美柔弱的身影，心中对于她的看法也逐渐变化。如今，小南已经不是个普通少女，她在自己内心占据了重要的位置，是自己的知心之人。
“重生，呵呵。果然，事物都是有着阴阳两面啊。”夜天云幽幽叹道，语气中的惊喜不溢言表。
走出房中，看着正在厨房忙碌的小南，夜天云微微一笑，上前帮忙。
小南的手艺不差，毕竟自己独自生活了很长时间，而且能够用到的多数都是一些菜梗、野菜一类难以下咽的食材，若是没有过关的厨艺，在讨不到食物的情况下是不可能生存下去的。
不过巧妇难为无米之炊，食材的质量确实太差，而且小南毕竟年龄和经历实在有限，食物不说是难以下咽，但味道确实有些值得商榷。
夜天云倒也不计较，帮助小南收拾了碗筷后，叫住了她：“小南，今晚我给你做饭吧。”
“啊，哦，好吧。”小南一时有些奇怪，但并没有拒绝。”不会自己做的太难吃了吧。”心中有些担忧，瞥了一眼夜天云，但映入眼帘的是一张温柔宠溺的笑脸，她思来想去也找不到原因。
“今天你在家歇息吧，我出去弄些吃的。”夜天云继续说道，没有给小南拒绝的时间，将剩余的碗筷交给了小南，自己便离开了屋子。
是夜，大多的村民吃过饭后早早的沉睡过去，只是在昏暗的街道上，一抹光亮极为显眼，十分醒目，正是小南与夜天云的住所。
夜天云已经一日未归，小南的心中如同乱麻一般，心中惴惴不安，倚着桌椅，默默的注视着前方跳动的烛光，心中期盼着夜天云的回归。
经过了昨夜的相处，小南在夜天云心中占有了极大的地位，夜天云在小南心中又何尝不是如此。今日清晨，小南嘴上说是将夜天云当做弟弟，但事实如何即便小南自己也理不清，只得将这一朦胧之感归咎到了姐弟的范畴。
“吱“，门板被推开，小南急忙转头望去，一道熟悉的身影缓缓走了进来。
“天云，你。。你怎么了！？”小南看清夜天云此时的神态，心中一惊，紧张的叫了出来。
夜天云此时头发蓬乱，本就朴素的布衣已经被撕烂成了几块碎条，衣着片缕，仅仅遮盖住上身躯体，而露出的肌肤透出了一丝丝血痕，脸上也沾有血污，整个人看起来狼狈不已，似是经历了一场艰苦的搏斗。
“没事儿。”夜天云笑了下，转身走去，在小南惊愕的目光中，夜天云竟将一只野猪拖了进来。
小南的小嘴张得能容下一颗鸡蛋，野猪身长足近两米，獠牙一尺有余，即便是几个成年人也未必能将其制服，而一个小孩儿能够杀死一头野猪可谓是匪夷所思，甚至是骇人听闻。
实际上夜天云的伤势并不重，皮肉之苦而已，只是看起来比较狼狈。
看到小南关切的神色，夜天云心中一暖，柔声说道：“去拿些火来。”
content_en:
A graceful girl with a long eyebrow, purple hair and jade cheeks, gently spitting the fragrance of lotus. Xiaonan leaned against the bed, immersed in her dream as gracefully as Sleeping Beauty, her red lips slightly raised with a hint of a smile.
Ye Tianyun carefully recalled last night's deeds, and suddenly found that the dream was too real. He guessed in his heart and got a vague answer.
"Was it Xiaonan's dream last night?" Ye Tianyun thought honestly. When he saw Xiaonan lying quietly beside the bed, with a slightly wet towel lying flat beside the pillow, he felt a touch of warmth and gratitude in his heart.
"This little girl is quite thoughtful." With a satisfied smile on his face, Ye Tianyun smoothed Xiaonan's somewhat messy hair.
Xiaonan snorted and woke up. She was still a little dazed because she slept on the bed all night. Her eyes were hazy and dull, and she looked around in confusion.
"Come back to your senses." Ye Tianyun stretched out his five fingers and patted Xiaonan's cheek. The soft touch was quite beneficial to Ye Tianyun.
"Ah, Tianyun, you're awake." Xiaonan woke up and recalled what happened last night. She felt slightly embarrassed and a trace of blush appeared on her face. She was speechless for a moment.
Although it was not obvious, who Ye Tianyun was, as a top killer, he naturally caught this change easily, and with his mind running, he speculated on what happened, and immediately understood the embarrassment in Xiaonan's heart. Thinking of this, Ye Tianyun felt a little embarrassed and a little surprised at the same time. After all, Xiaonan was only a nine-year-old girl. Although people in the Naruto world in the comics were a little precocious, it was too early.
The two of them had their own thoughts, and the room suddenly became quiet and silent. However, the atmosphere at this time seemed a little strange, a little dull, a little awkward, but still slightly ambiguous.
But Ye Tianyun didn't pay attention to this. He walked out of his thoughts first and broke the tranquility.
"Xiaonan, why are you in my room?"
The topic was successfully changed, and most of the embarrassment in Xiaonan's heart was dispelled, and she began to slowly reveal the causes and consequences of last night. "Tianyun, are you worried about anything?" Xiaonan asked about last night's doubts, looking at Ye Tianyun in anticipation of his answer.
Ye Tianyun smiled and shook his head, but the smile was slightly bitter, and the sadness in his eyes disappeared in a flash.
"I'm sorry, Tianyun." Realizing Ye Tianyun's melancholy, Xiaonan secretly blamed herself for being careless and said apologetically.
"It's okay." Looking at Xiaonan who was a little flustered, Ye Tianyun couldn't help but sigh at Xiaonan's kindness, and at the same time, his gratitude to Xiaonan increased even more.
"Tianyun, although we just met by chance, you rescued me and helped me. If you have any pain in your heart, don't bear it yourself. I hope that one day I can help you share it with you. I have always regarded you as my younger brother. My parents are dead, and you are the person closest to me. We will live together, find our place in this troubled world, and live forever!"
Xiaonan's tone was gentle and gentle, but her words were as firm as stone. The smiling face was like the spring breeze blowing through the willows, warming the scarred heart. Ye Tianyun looked at Xiaonan and couldn't calm down for a long time.
"Thank you." The voice was also trembling. After many years, he tasted the feeling of being cared for again, and Ye Tianyun suppressed the surging heart.
"Hehe." Xiaonan smiled brightly, turned around and walked out of the house. "Let's eat later." came the voice, extremely happy.
I have been alone for half my life, with only a sharp knife by my side. I have been killing for ten years, and I have no intention of ever being alone. Thinking about the past life, the sharpness was bloody and empty, and the lonely night was sad. I lamented the happiness and warmth, only the midnight dreams. In this life, the slender and delicate girl has aroused three thousand thoughts, healed the scarred heart, and promised the whole world.
Ye Tianyun looked at Xiaonan's delicate and delicate figure, and his view of her gradually changed. Nowadays, Xiaonan is no longer an ordinary girl. She occupies an important position in her heart and is her confidant.
"Rebirth, haha. Sure enough, everything has two sides, Yin and Yang." Ye Tianyun sighed quietly, the surprise in his tone was undeniable.
After walking out of the room and looking at Xiaonan who was busy in the kitchen, Ye Tianyun smiled slightly and stepped forward to help.
Xiaonan's cooking skills are not bad. After all, she has lived alone for a long time, and most of the ingredients she can use are some hard-to-eat ingredients such as vegetable stems and wild vegetables. Without good cooking skills, it is impossible to survive without food.
However, it is difficult for a good woman to cook without rice. The quality of the ingredients is indeed too poor, and after all, Xiaonan's age and experience are really limited. The food is not difficult to swallow, but the taste is indeed questionable.
Ye Tianyun didn't care. After helping Xiaonan clean up the dishes, he stopped her and said, "Xiaonan, let me cook for you tonight."
"Ah, oh, okay." Xiaonan was a little strange for a moment, but she didn't refuse. "You won't make it too bad." She was a little worried and glanced at Ye Tianyun, but what came into her eyes was a gentle and doting smile, and she couldn't find the reason after thinking about it.
"You can rest at home today. I'll go out and get some food." Ye Tianyun continued. Without giving Xiaonan time to refuse, he handed the remaining bowls and chopsticks to Xiaonan and left the house.
It was night, and most of the villagers fell asleep early after eating. However, in the dim street, a ray of light was extremely conspicuous and eye-catching. It was the residence of Xiao Nan and Ye Tianyun.
Ye Tianyun has not returned for a day, Xiaonan's heart is like a mess, and she is uneasy. She leans on the table and chair, silently watching the beating candlelight in front of her, looking forward to Ye Tianyun's return in her heart.
After getting along last night, Xiaonan occupies a great position in Ye Tianyun's heart, and Ye Tianyun also holds the same position in Xiaonan's heart. This morning, Xiaonan said that she regarded Ye Tianyun as her younger brother, but even Xiaonan herself couldn't figure out the reality, so she had to attribute this hazy feeling to the category of sibling.
"Squeak", the door panel was pushed open, Xiaonan quickly turned around and looked, and a familiar figure slowly walked in.
"Tianyun, you...what's wrong with you!?" Xiaonan was shocked when she saw Ye Tianyun's demeanor at this time and cried out nervously.
Ye Tianyun's hair was disheveled at this time, and his simple cloth had been torn into several pieces. The pieces of clothing only covered his upper body, and the exposed skin showed traces of blood, and his face was also stained with blood. He looked embarrassed, as if he had experienced a hard struggle.
"It's okay." Ye Tianyun smiled, turned around and walked away. In Xiaonan's shocked eyes, Ye Tianyun actually dragged a wild boar in.
Xiao Nan's mouth was wide enough to hold an egg. The wild boar was nearly two meters long and had tusks over a foot long. Even a few adults might not be able to subdue it. It was unbelievable and even horrifying that a child could kill a wild boar.
In fact, Ye Tianyun's injury was not serious, just a physical pain, but he looked rather embarrassed.
Seeing Xiao Nan's concerned look, Ye Tianyun felt warm in his heart and said softly: "Go get some fire."
title_en: Chapter 6: The person you want to protect for life Chapter 7: War is coming
